map.输入毛利率或客单价与广告成本占比，计算广告投放刚好不亏不赚的最低ROAS，用于设: Enter gross margin, or average order value and the ad cost share, to compute the minimum ROAS at which advertising just breaks even, for setting a profit floor and bid ceiling.
map.定投放 KPI 前先算 ROAS 低于多少就亏钱。: Before setting delivery KPIs, compute the ROAS below which you lose money.
map.设目标利润率反推需要做到的目标 ROAS。: Set a target profit margin and back-solve the target ROAS needed.
map.评估当前 ROAS 处于优秀/良好/微利哪一档。: Assess whether current ROAS sits in the excellent / good / thin-margin band.
map.毛利率定平衡线: Gross margin sets the break-even line
map.：毛利率 40% → 盈亏平衡 ROAS=1/(40/100)=2.5。即 RO: : gross margin 40% -> break-even ROAS = 1/(40/100) = 2.5. That is, ROAS must be at least 2.5 to avoid loss; at the current ROAS of 3 the profit margin = 40% − 1/3 ≈ 6.7%, thin profit.
map.目标利润率反推: Back-solve from a target profit margin
map.：毛利率 40%、目标利润率 10% → 目标 ROAS=1/(0.4−0.1): : gross margin 40%, target profit margin 10% -> target ROAS = 1/(0.4 − 0.1) = 3.33, so delivery must reach 3.33x to bank a 10% net margin.
map.用（收入−货成本−履约）/收入，含运费退换更准；只扣进货成本会低估平衡 ROAS: Use (revenue − cost of goods − fulfillment) / revenue, including shipping and returns for accuracy; deducting only purchase cost understates break-even ROAS.
map.ROAS 达标但还亏？: ROAS hits target but still losing money?
map.可能漏算固定成本/退货运费，盈亏平衡 ROAS 仅覆盖变动毛利，净利还要再留安全: Probably fixed costs or return shipping were left out: break-even ROAS only covers variable gross margin, so net profit needs another safety cushion.
